Depends on the Ice Islands Quest and collecting shards

The {wiki:Norseman Outfits|Norseman Outfit} protects you from the endless winter of {wiki:Hrodmir|Hrodmir}. You get the outfit by completing {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest|The Ice Islands Quest} and the addons by handing frostheart shards ({item:Shard|Shards}) to the shaman {npc:Hjaern}, in Svargrond: 5 shards for the Spear and 10 more for the Hood/Earmuffs. You also get the achievement **Out in the Snowstorm**.
After handing in 15 shards in total.
